A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same LongMemEval benchmark and memory framework. Their main text, figures, tables, mathematical content, and Appendices A–E are readable, allowing reliable comparison and matching of relocated material.

before.justification: v1 reports original commercial-chatbot evaluations, long-context LLM experiments, memory-design ablations, and evaluator validation.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical studies and adds evaluations of additional language models.

M1.justification: Session decomposition, fact-augmented keys, temporal query expansion, and Chain-of-Note with JSON remain unchanged. The additional framework formalization does not establish a new implemented algorithm or memory component.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 500-question benchmark, LongMemEval S/M settings, question types, and 97-question commercial-system study. Additional model evaluations and a replaced illustrative knowledge-update example do not establish changed dataset or task coverage.

E2.justification: v2 adds Phi-3.5 Mini to the long-context pilot. Appendix E.1 also compares long-context and memory configurations for Llama-3.2 1B/3B, Qwen2.5-7B, Phi-3.5 Mini, and Mistral-NeMo. These extend the backbone comparisons; the BM25, Contriever, and Stella retriever comparisons remain unchanged.

E3.justification: The new model block adds oracle/full-history reading and round-based retrieval configurations across S/M. The pilot also relabels one Llama-3.1 configuration from 8B to 70B while retaining its scores; this does not establish a rerun. Existing metrics, evaluation judge, and data construction remain unchanged.

E4.justification: New Appendix E.1 extends paired Chain-of-Note and fact-key-expansion comparisons to additional backbones, testing their generality. Existing value-granularity, retriever, rank-merging, temporal-query, and error analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The evaluator-validation sample counts and reporting practice are unchanged.

E6.justification: New Table 8 substantially extends results across model families and small-model configurations under oracle, full-history, and memory conditions. For example, newly reported Mistral-NeMo S accuracy is 0.640 with K=V and 0.666 with K=V+fact. Phi-3.5 pilot results are also added. Existing main retrieval tables retain their values; revised percentage summaries do not represent improved experimental scores.

T1.justification: New Appendix C.1 explicitly defines indexing, query formulation, salience scoring, and reading functions, including an online indexing variant that can edit or remove stored items. This adds limited formal definitions without introducing theorems or proofs.

C1.justification: The benchmark and memory-design contributions remain the same. The introduction revises headline key-expansion gains from 4% recall and 5% QA to 9.4% and 5.4%, and explicitly conditions the temporal-retrieval benefit on a strong query-expansion LLM. These refine the quantitative contribution claims.

C2.justification: The new Ethics Statement discusses information leakage, the absence of a memory-deletion operator, and malicious memory insertion causing jailbreak behavior, with moderation proposed as mitigation. Existing explanations of retrieval, compression, and reading failures largely remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 newly documents source and planned dataset licenses, content screening, annotator expertise, and approximately 400 construction hours plus 150 evaluation hours. It removes v1's statement that experiments used eight NVIDIA A6000 GPUs. Appendix prompts and decoding instructions are retained.

R1.justification: Related work adds MultiWOZ, AirDialogue, CoQA, and SituatedQA as background, alongside references for the additional evaluated models. The positioning against existing memory benchmarks and the nine-system framework comparison remain substantially unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 edits the introduction and methodological explanations, consolidates History Compilation into Section 3.2, and adds ethics and appendix subsections. The main section sequence and most existing appendix prose remain intact.

P2.justification: v2 adds the model-results table and a pilot model-size column, revises illustrative figures, and corrects control-point labels. Dataset statistics move to the appendix, while the nine-system comparison moves into the main text. Table captions and plot axes receive limited formatting changes.

improvement.justification: Additional backbone experiments strengthen evidence for generality, while clearer formalization, corrected summaries and labels, and annotation disclosures improve clarity and transparency. The core method and main findings remain stable. Removed hardware details and unexplained Phi-3.5 score differences between Figure 3 and Table 8 limit the gain.
